beats.say: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Neon targets fast end-to-end task completion for software engineering, knowledge work and science, priced at $3/$15 per million input/output tokens with a 1M-token context.
Google says Neon scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its xhigh thinking level, ranks 2 on the Vals Index and 2 on steerability in the new Agent Arena Index.
On our agentic behavior evaluation, Neon builds on Carbon’s strong baseline by further reducing under-service by 43%-56% and overreach by 15%-35% across different effort levels.
